title: kbmon's delivery alert clears on a later locked or waiting apply line that delivered nothing
goal: the querylog delivery alert stays until an apply outcome that delivered (pushed or nothing to push), as bl_land.last_push_failure reads it; a locked or waiting line leaves it standing

run:

say('  gate querylog.py check: FAILED (exit 1): planted problem');say('apply --push: kbgit.py sync exit 1; nothing pushed')
